_comment: sim-robust-collect-place-straightline-v1 (collect4). Purpose: let the honest COLLECT deck place COMPLETE after the upright preplace, without cuMotion rejecting the final place config. With the PR 209 goal fix + PR 213 parking-gate fix, collect4 reached the upright preplace AND the host planned the place descent, but cuMotion rejected the PLACE config as an ATTACHED-OBJECT SELF-COLLISION: 'Invalid c-space position: self collision detected' (host-stack.log: 6 self-collisions, 0 world collisions). The held carton is a 34-sphere cuMotion attached_object (isaac_motion.attach_object_world at gripper_tcp) NOT self-collision-ignored vs the forearm/wrist/upper-arm, so the set-down fold brings the carton spheres inside the attached-object self-collision margin EVEN THOUGH the bare arm is self-clear there (+0.0339 m at BOTH the upright preplace and the place) and PR 209's wrist-guard accepted the config (WRIST_GUARD accept q=[0.095,-1.503,1.839,-0.336,1.858,0]). The cart deck is NOT a cuMotion WORLD object for this run (world_obstacles:[], base_collision_object:false), so there is nothing to make collision-aware -- this is purely the conservative attached-carton self-check of the intended set-down. Fix = the cart-cage / live_pose (PR 215) mechanism: route the place descent + empty retreat as the collision-OFF straight-line seeded insert; the preplace standoff stays collision-aware. Absent/false => byte-identical.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> TransferController).
_collect_place_straight_line_note: Route the NON-cage COLLECT deck PLACE descent through begin(straight_line=True) -- the SAME collision-off seeded 2-point insert the cart-cage place and the live_pose transfer place (PR 215) already use (one shared `straight` predicate in controller.py step(), no second mechanism). The PREPLACE standoff stays collision-aware (the fixed upright collect_place_preplace_shape joint goal), so the arm reaches the standoff ABOVE the deck with full collision checking, then lowers the carton straight down onto the deck -- touching the deck with the held carton is the intent, exactly like the straight-line contact descent at the pick. Scoped to the non-cage collect place (operation=collect, cart_cage_place false); transfer / live_pose / scripted-still runs are untouched. false/absent => the collision-aware joint-space place (byte-identical, i.e. the collect4 behaviour that cuMotion rejects). Validated in tests/test_restock_manipulation.py (test_collect_deck_place_*).
_collect_stow_branch_note: sim-robust-collect-stow-branch-v1 (collect5): the empty-handed RETREAT after the carton release now backs the gripper to the FIXED clear upright shape (collect_place_preplace_shape) via a collision-OFF straight-line JOINT smoothstep (begin_joint_goal(straight_line=True)), NOT a collision-off pose-IK straight-line. Why: with collision-avoidance off the pose-IK retreat branched into a DROOPED config where the forearm sat ~18 mm inside the gripper-cube (cube_without_surface_plates) sphere margin (collect5 retreat endpoint [0.214,-1.755,2.075,-0.320,1.975,0], FK TCP ~10 cm below the standoff); the NEXT move is the collision-AWARE staged retreat_tuck, and cuMotion rejected that self-colliding START ('Invalid c-space position: self collision detected' -> INVALID_INITIAL_CSPACE_POSITION -> MANIP_HOST_FAILED op=collect -> arm heartbeat lost). Returning to the fixed clear shape via a collision-off smoothstep un-folds the arm monotonically out of the cube margin to a self-clear config, so retreat_tuck/stow then plan from a valid start. NO new key: this engages whenever collect_place_straight_line AND collect_place_preplace_shape are both set (the collect5 staging). collect_place_straight_line WITHOUT collect_place_preplace_shape now FAILS BY NAME at the retreat ('collect deck retreat has no clear-branch escape shape') rather than stowing into the self-colliding fold. Validated in tests/test_restock_manipulation.py (test_collect_deck_place_routes_place_and_retreat_straight_line, test_collect_deck_retreat_fails_by_name_without_a_clear_escape_shape) and tests/test_restock_collect_stow_branch.py (sphere-level, on the real URDF + mission XRDF model).
_requires: The HOST block must already carry the PR 209 upright place-goal keys (collect_place_preplace_shape + collect_place_wrist_guard) and reposition_before_place:true with cart_cage_place:false, plus the PR 211/213 descent/parking keys in their own blocks (RUNTIME collect_place_base_settle_m, HOST release_detach_timeout_s). Register collect_place_straight_line in the run's --require preflight (config_preflight knows it as a HOST key).
_bounded_gpu_proof: Run the UNCHANGED collect5 staging (GROUND-TRUTH collect RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1, RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=scripted, cage_collision filtered, transfer_carry weld+wrist_guard, PR 203/208/209/211/213 keys + collect_place_straight_line:true + collect_place_preplace_shape; the collect5 HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG -- NO new key) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr; never --force; never touch the whispr service). Expected PASS: the place reaches the upright preplace, the place DESCENT routes straight-line (no 'Invalid c-space position' at the place config), the gripper-open detaches the weld (release_detach_timeout_s), THEN the empty retreat backs to the upright escape shape via the collision-off straight-line JOINT smoothstep so the staged retreat_tuck NO LONGER hits 'Invalid c-space position: self collision detected' / INVALID_INITIAL_CSPACE_POSITION / MANIP_HOST_FAILED op=collect at its start, the arm stows to the transport pose, and collect reports DONE (transport_ready True) so couple can begin. If a DIFFERENT move now fails, capture its host-stack.log line (collision class + which config) rather than widening this switch.
